recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It narrowly completes the metadata change needed for CarePlan to match the Applied Jira resolution; any remaining Patient Care resource maturity issues should be handled by their own issue-specific reconciliation commits.
issue_request: FHIR-46580 asked to increase the FHIR-core CarePlan resource maturity level. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution says that, in alignment with the September 2025 Patient Care WGM vote, CarePlan is planned to go normative in R6 with FMM = 6.
initial_application: The current source already marked CarePlan's structuredefinition-standards-status as normative. Git commit 5c20769cc74459a8c1057d2747418dc4340f4244 applied that status-code change broadly but left CarePlan's structuredefinition-fmm extension at value 2, so the maturity metadata was only partially applied. No existing combined-branch commit for Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-46580 was present before this work.
additional_context: CarePlan is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml is the authoritative source for the generated resource maturity badge. The September 2025 Patient Care WGM minutes and March 2026 maturity-comment Zulip thread support resolving Patient Care maturity comments based on the intended normative R6 direction. Neighboring maturity issues for Goal and CareTeam are the same family but involve separate resources; CareTeam's related issue is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml so the structuredefinition-fmm extension value is 6 instead of 2. No generated artifacts or unrelated CarePlan content were changed.
source_changes: source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml: changed the CarePlan structuredefinition-fmm value from 2 to 6.
